always_available.description: Show timer suggestions in unprefixed launcher search, so 2h5m works without /timer.
always_available.label: Always available in launcher

hide_when_idle.description: Hide the widget when no timers are running.
hide_when_idle.label: Hide when idle

idle_color.description: Ring color when no timers are running.
idle_color.label: Idle color

safe_color.description: Ring color while more than half the timer remains, or the only color when timer colors are off.
safe_color.label: Safe color

show_count.description: Show the number of timers inside the ring.
show_count.label: Show count

show_progress.description: Draw a progress ring for the nearest timer.
show_progress.label: Show progress ring

show_text.description: Show the estimated remaining time next to the ring.
show_text.label: Show time

urgent_color.description: Ring color when a fifth or less of the timer remains.
urgent_color.label: Urgent color

use_urgency_colors.description: Switch the ring from the safe color to warning and urgent as the timer runs out.
use_urgency_colors.label: Timer colors

warning_color.description: Ring color when half or less of the timer remains.
warning_color.label: Warning color
